title: Starting a Space conversation never blames a full contact list for a contact that was created at the same moment

source.ref: Scan nine (2026-10-19 weekly meta scan), docs/META-SCAN-STATUS.md

detail: createSpaceCounterpart (New conversation, #3400) returned null on any insert failure, and the caller then told the manager 'Your contact list is full'. A unique-key race (a double send, or the contact arriving between the lookup and the insert) is not a full list. On a 23505 the action now re-reads the contact that won, as ensureSpaceContact does for the inbox.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/crm/conversations-actions.ts','utf8');const i=s.indexOf('async function createSpaceCounterpart');const b=i<0?'':s.slice(i,i+2000);if(!/error\\?\\.code === '23505'\\)\\s*return await resolveSpaceCounterpart\\(/.test(b)){console.error('SCAN-1003: a contact insert race is reported as a full contact list');process.exit(1)}"
